meta.title: CHUNK VST3 — Multiband Channel Strip | Assembly DSP
meta.description: Windows VST3 channel strip. EQ, compressor, and resonance suppressor. CHUNK is free.

hero.lede: A comprehensive, yet lightweight channel strip, with total dynamic and EQ control.

layers.headline: EQ, COMP, and RS.
layers.eqBody: Each band can be any filter type, HP/LP, shelf, bell or variable width plateau.  Each one is dynamic with +/- 24db dynamic range, compression or expansion.  Solo a band to hear only the frequencies it is processing.
layers.eqAlt: CHUNK EQ window — multiband equalizer with spectrum graph and band controls
layers.compBody: Six frequency regions can be created.  Each one has Threshold, Ratio, Attack, Release, Knee and Range, along with Gate with Threshold, Release, and Ratio.  Sidechain one band to another simply by dragging a connector from one band to another.
layers.compAlt: CHUNK COMP window — multiband compressor with transfer curve and dynamics controls
layers.rsBody: Four regions can be created.  Each one is made of dozens of narrow band compressors.  Great for taming lingering resonances and de-essing.
layers.rsAlt: CHUNK RS window — resonance suppressor with spectral gain reduction

extras.headline: Also included.
extras.inAlt: CHUNK input page — level, harmonics, gain, and phase
extras.outAlt: CHUNK output page — level, brickwall limiter, width, and harmonics
